name: Letenye (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the town arms of Letenye (a red, white and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, a house, a rose, a bird and bars) below the name LETENYE in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
